Sectional Property Surveys & Sectional Plan Preparation in Kenya.

We prepare geo-referenced sectional plans for apartments, offices, and mixed-use developments for registration under the Sectional Properties Act, 2020.

description.en:
SmartGrid provides certified sectional property surveys (strata plans) that comply with local land registry requirements. 

We map common property, exclusive use areas, unit extents and prepare certified floor plans and area schedules ready for submission.

question.en: What is a “sectional plan” and when is it required?
question.sw: Ni nini "mpango wa sehemu" na unahitajika lini?

answer.en:
Under Section 4 of the Act of Kenya, a “sectional plan” is the document by which an existing structure or parcel is divided into two or more units for separate ownership. The Act applies to land held on freehold or on leasehold with at least 21 years remaining.

How we comply at SmartGrid:
answer.sw:
Chini ya Sehemu ya 4 ya Sheria ya Kenya, "mpango wa sehemu" ni hati kwa ajili ya kugawanya muundo au sehemu iliyopo katika vitengo viwili au zaidi kwa umiliki tofauti. Sheria inatumika kwa ardhi inayomilikiwa kwa freehold au leasehold yenye mwaka angalau 21 uliosalia.

Jinsi tunavyozingatia SmartGrid:

points.en: We engage licensed surveyors to prepare geo‑referenced sectional plans meeting the legal criteria (see Section 9) including clear unit delineation, unit factors, and common property mapping.
points.sw: Tunatumia wapima ardhi walioidhinishwa kuandaa mipango ya sehemu iliyorejelewa kijiografia inayokidhi vigezo vya kisheria (tazama Sehemu ya 9) ikiwa pamoja na ufafanuzi wazi wa vitengo, mambo ya vitengo, na uchoraji wa ramani ya mali ya pamoja.

points.en: We verify that the head‑title (mother parcel) is valid (freehold or leasehold with ≥21 years remaining) before initiating the plan.
points.sw: Tunathibitisha kwamba hati-kuu ya umiliki (parcel mama) ni halali (freehold au leasehold yenye mwaka ≥21 uliosalia) kabla ya kuanza mpango.

question.en: What are the technical and regulatory requirements for a sectional plan?
question.sw: Ni mahitaji gani ya kiufundi na kikanuni kwa mpango wa sehemu?

answer.en:
The Act’s Section 9 sets out the requirements: the plan must be geo‑referenced, have a heading stating “Sectional Plan”, show unit boundaries by floors/walls/ceilings, have a schedule of unit‑factors, show user category, and be signed by the proprietor and the survey authority. 

 Additionally, Section 11 requires endorsements: by a surveyor certifying that the units lie within the parcel boundaries, and by the county government approving the building division.

How SmartGrid complies:
answer.sw:
Sehemu ya 9 ya Sheria inaweka mahitaji: mpango lazima urejelewe kijiografia, uwe na kichwa kinachosema "Sectional Plan", uonyeshe mipaka ya vitengo kwa sakafu/kuta/dari, uwe na ratiba ya mambo ya vitengo, uonyeshe kategoria ya mtumiaji, na utiwe saini na mwenye mali na mamlaka ya upimaji. 

 Zaidi ya hayo, Sehemu ya 11 inahitaji uidhinisho: wa mchunguzi anayethibitisha kwamba vitengo viko ndani ya mipaka ya kiwanja, na wa serikali ya kaunti ikikubali mgawanyo wa jengo.

Jinsi SmartGrid inavyozingatia:

points.en: We perform GNSS/total‑station surveys and deliver a geo‑referenced CAD drawing that aligns with the parcel’s coordinates and registry survey control.
points.sw: Tunafanya uchunguzi wa GNSS/total-station na kutoa mchoro wa CAD uliorejelewa kijiografia unaoendana na kuratibu za kiwanja na mfumo wa udhibiti wa usajili.

points.en: We liaise with the county government’s building approval authority to ensure the division conforms with approved building plans and obtain the required certificate before registration.
points.sw: Tunashirikiana na mamlaka ya uidhinishaji wa majengo ya serikali ya kaunti kuhakikisha mgawanyo unaoendana na mipango iliyoidhinishwa ya jengo na kupata cheti kinachohitajika kabla ya usajili.

points.en: Our deliverable includes the schedule of unit‑factors and common‑property share calculations.
points.sw: Bidhaa zetu zinajumuisha ratiba ya mambo ya vitengo na mahesabu ya hisa za mali ya pamoja.

question.en: What happens after a sectional plan is registered?
question.sw: Nini hufanyika baada ya mpango wa sehemu kusajiliwa?

answer.en:
Once registered (under Section 5), the register of the original parcel is closed, separate registers are opened for each unit, and each unit gets its own certificate of title (freehold) or certificate of lease (leasehold). The interest in the common property is shown. 

Moreover, the corporation (body corporate) is automatically constituted under Section 17 to manage the common property.

How SmartGrid complies:
answer.sw:
Mara tu ukisajiliwa (chini ya Sehemu ya 5), rejesta ya kiwanja cha awali hufungwa, rejesta tofauti hufunguliwa kwa kila kitengo, na kila kitengo kinapata cheti chake cha umiliki (freehold) au cheti cha kukodisha (leasehold). Maslahi katika mali ya pamoja yanaonyeshwa. 

Zaidi ya hayo, shirika (body corporate) huundwa moja kwa moja chini ya Sehemu ya 17 kusimamia mali ya pamoja.

Jinsi SmartGrid inavyozingatia:

points.en: Our surveys clearly mark the common property and exclusive‑use areas so that the title deed can contain the correct share in common property (Section 6).
points.sw: Uchunguzi wetu unaweka wazi mali ya pamoja na maeneo ya matumizi ya kipekee ili hati ya umiliki iweze kuwa na hisa sahihi ya mali ya pamoja (Sehemu ya 6).

points.en: We provide the documentation in a format compatible with the land registry so that the register can be updated efficiently.
points.sw: Tunatoa nyaraka katika muundo unaoendana na rejesta ya ardhi ili rejesta iweze kusasishwa kwa ufanisi.

question.en: What rights and obligations do unit owners have under the Sectional Act of Kenya?
question.sw: Wamiliki wa vitengo wana haki na wajibu gani chini ya Sheria ya Sehemu ya Kenya?

answer.en:
Under Section 7, each unit and the common property enjoy rights of support, shelter, and access to services (including water, sewer, and electricity) as appurtenant rights. 

 Section 8 states that an owner’s liability for burdens on common property is proportionate to their unit factor. 

How SmartGrid complies:
answer.sw:
Chini ya Sehemu ya 7, kila kitengo na mali ya pamoja hufurahia haki za msaada, makao, na ufikiaji wa huduma (ikijumuisha maji, mfumo wa maji taka, na umeme) kama haki za appurtenant. 

 Sehemu ya 8 inasema kwamba dhima ya mmiliki kwa mizigo kwenye mali ya pamoja inalingana na kipengele chao cha kitengo. 

Jinsi SmartGrid inavyozingatia:

points.en: In our unit schedules, we compute the unit‑factor (proportional share) correctly so that owners’ liability and voting rights (in the corporation) are determined fairly.
points.sw: Katika ratiba zetu za vitengo, tunahesabu kipengele cha kitengo (hisa ya uwiano) kwa usahihi ili dhima ya wamiliki na haki za kupiga kura (katika shirika) ziamuliwe kwa haki.

points.en: Our survey deliverables map service routes and easements so the rights of access and services are clearly defined and documented.
points.sw: Bidhaa zetu za uchunguzi zinaweka ramani za njia za huduma na easements ili haki za ufikiaji na huduma zifafanuliwe na kuandikwe waziwazi.

question.en: Why convert existing long‑term leases to sectional titles?
question.sw: Kwa nini kubadilisha kodi za muda mrefu zilizopo kuwa hatimiliki za sehemu?

answer.en:
Section 13 of the Act mandates that a building containing premises not included in a sectional plan cannot be sold as a unit until the plan is registered. 

 Additionally, the Regulation requires geo‑referencing of sectional plans and the conversion of older long‑term leases where necessary.

 How SmartGrid complies:
answer.sw:
Sehemu ya 13 ya Sheria inaamuru kwamba jengo linalojumuisha majengo yasiyojumuishwa katika mpango wa sehemu haliwezi kuuzwa kama kitengo hadi mpango huo usajiliwe. 

 Zaidi ya hayo, Kanuni inahitaji kurejelewa kijiografia kwa mipango ya sehemu na ubadilishaji wa kodi za zamani za muda mrefu pale inapohitajika.

 Jinsi SmartGrid inavyozingatia:

points.en: For older developments, we undertake the diagnostics: we check existing leases, confirm if a sectional plan exists, and if not, we prepare and geo–reference a new plan, enabling lawful conversion.
points.sw: Kwa maendeleo ya zamani, tunafanya uchunguzi (diagnostics): tunaangalia kodi zilizopo, tunathibitisha kama mpango wa sehemu upo, na kama haupo, tunaandaa na kurejelea kijiografia mpango mpya, kuwezesha ubadilishaji halali.

points.en: We work with legal advisors and the land registry to ensure the conversion process is correctly managed and the new titles are issued.
points.sw: Tunafanya kazi na washauri wa kisheria na rejesta ya ardhi kuhakikisha mchakato wa ubadilishaji unasimamiwa kwa usahihi na hatimiliki mpya inatolewa.

question.en: What are the consequences of non‑compliance?

answer.en:
Failure to register a sectional plan when required means any sale, transfer or financing based on a unit without proper title may be unenforceable.

 The Registrar may place a restriction on a title if a developer fails to convert (per Section 13).

 How at SmartGrid surveying complies:
answer.sw:
Kushindwa kusajili mpango wa sehemu inapohitajika kunamaanisha kwamba mauzo, uhamisho au ufadhili wowote kulingana na kitengo bila hati sahihi yanaweza kutoishia kutekelezeka.

 Msajili anaweza kuweka kizuizi kwenye hati kama mwendelezaji atashindwa kubadilisha (kulingana na Sehemu ya 13).

 Jinsi SmartGrid Surveying inavyozingatia:

points.en: We ensure that our services guard against non‑compliance by delivering survey plans that meet legal registration requirements—so developers/owners can avoid the risk of transactions being invalid.
points.sw: Tunahakikisha huduma zetu zinalinda dhidi ya kutozingatia kwa kutoa mipango ya uchunguzi inayokidhi mahitaji ya usajili wa kisheria—ili waendelezaji/wamiliki waepuke hatari ya shughuli kutofanya kazi.

points.en: Our quality control process ensures that the sectional plan is registered and titles can issue, avoiding restrictions or penalties.
points.sw: Mchakato wetu wa udhibiti wa ubora unahakikisha kwamba mpango wa sehemu unasajiliwa na hatimiliki zinaweza kutolewa, kuepuka vikwazo au adhabu.

question.en: How do boundary and encroachment issues work for sectional properties?
question.sw: Masuala ya mipaka na uvamizi hushughulikiwaje kwa mali za sehemu?

answer.en:
The Act requires that the sectional plan be prepared by a surveyor who certifies that the structure lies within the parcel boundaries and that any easements (e.g., for overhangs) are granted. 

Section 10 deals with boundaries of units: if a load‑bearing wall forms a boundary, the finishing materials inside count as part of the unit. 

 How at SmartGrid surveying complies:
answer.sw:
Sheria inahitaji kwamba mpango wa sehemu uandaliwe na mchunguzi anayethibitisha kwamba muundo upo ndani ya mipaka ya kiwanja na kwamba easements zozote (k.m., kwa overhangs) zinatolewa. 

 Sehemu ya 10 inahusu mipaka ya vitengo: ikiwa ukuta wa kubeba mzigo unafanya mipaka, nyenzo za kumalizia ndani huhesabiwa kama sehemu ya kitengo. 

 Jinsi SmartGrid Surveying inavyozingatia:

points.en: We perform full boundary verification using GNSS/total station and produce control‑net coordinates tied to registry beacons; we then confirm that building footprints and projections (e.g., gutter overhangs) comply with recorded parcel boundaries.
points.sw: Tunafanya uhakiki kamili wa mipaka kwa kutumia GNSS/total station na kutoa kuratibu za mfumo wa udhibiti zilizounganishwa na alama za rejesta; kisha tunathibitisha kwamba alama za jengo na maramuko (kama overhangs za mifereji) zinaendana na mipaka iliyosajiliwa ya kiwanja.

points.en: We document encroachments or deviations, map them in CAD/PDF, and advise on required easements or amendments before submission to land registry.
points.sw: Tunarekodi uvamizi au kukengeuka, kuyachora kwenye CAD/PDF, na kushauri easements zinazohitajika au masahihisho kabla ya uwasilishaji kwa rejesta ya ardhi.

question.en: What sectional properties deliverables should a developer/owner expect from the surveyor?
question.sw: Ni bidhaa gani za mali za sehemu mwendelezaji/mwenye anapaswa kutarajia kutoka kwa mchunguzi?

answer.en:
The law expects a professionally prepared sectional plan (in quadruplicate) ready for registration, unit schedule with unit factors, geo‑referenced drawing, and county/certification endorsements. 

 How SmartGrid complies:
answer.sw:
Sheria inatarajia mpango wa sehemu ulioandaliwa kitaalamu (kwa nakala nne) tayari kwa usajili, ratiba ya vitengo yenye mambo ya vitengo, mchoro uliorejelewa kijiografia, na uidhinisho wa kaunti/cheti. 

 Jinsi SmartGrid inavyozingatia:

points.en: We provide a full deliverable package: geo‑referenced CAD drawings, PDF plans endorsed by licensed surveyor, unit‑factors schedule, coordinate report, certificate of compliance, and support documentation for registry submission.
points.sw: Tunatoa kifurushi kamili: michoro ya CAD iliyorejelewa kijiografia, mipango ya PDF iliyoidhinishwa na mchunguzi aliyeidhinishwa, ratiba ya mambo ya vitengo, ripoti ya kuratibu, cheti cha kufuata, na nyaraka za msaada kwa uwasilishaji wa rejesta.

points.en: We also assist in liaison with relevant authorities (county planning office, land registry) to ensure proper registration.
points.sw: Pia tunasaidia katika mawasiliano na mamlaka husika (ofisi ya mipango ya kaunti, rejesta ya ardhi) kuhakikisha usajili sahihi.

label.sw: Omba Nukuu ya Uchunguzi wa Mali za Sehemu
